sourceIdentity: The2 actual original high-kernel Bockstein RHS are reduced by the actual complete original T96 image basis. Every quotient and complete remainder is saved and G*Q+remainder=RHS is accumulated independently in all1034 components and last-two columns. Column labels are the actual graph kernel leading components, not original target indices. Only the infinite polynomial quotient is represented here; the true finiteB86 budget has not been tested.
